services.name: Midnight Rodeo
services.desc: Private Charters sits up to 14 passengers plus the captain So how much? Starting at $545 for 3 hour charters are possible Monday-Friday and Sunday with only 4 hour charters offered on Saturdays. 1 additional hour is possible on select charters. Friday-Sunday would be 10am-2pm and 3:15pm to 7:15pm. If there isn't a charter after yours, we can stay out as long as you'd like at discounted rate. There is an online convenience fee, however, you can pay with the Venmo app or over the phone and then the prices listed above are what you pay. Please give us a call if you are interested in a full day Seats up to 14 passengers plus the captain

blurb: When it comes to boat rentals, we are not the cheapest but we are the best!
extraNote: If you cancel within 14 days and 7 days we will hold $200 and refund the remaining balance. · We do not cancel or make advanced decisions based on the forecast. · If severe weather prevents us from completing your reservation as planned, we will only charge for the time enjoyed on the boat, up to a full refund (minus the non-refundable booking fee) if no part of the rental is completed. · 20% mandatory gratuity is required paid directly to your captain, via cash, venmo or cashapp. The card on file will be charged 7 days prior to your charter.
